findings.title: Node's container runtime has no handler for the RuntimeClass
findings.cause: the pod runs with RuntimeClass kd-nvidia, whose handler nvidia is not configured in the container runtime on node kd-faults-control-plane, so its sandbox is never created; Deployment infer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unable to get OCI runtime for sandbox "cd44a74180f378eab2bfeb5e149b287ad274f211256f8e6f063be69adf7150d7": no runtime for "nvidia" is configured

findings.fix: Run the pod only on nodes that have handler nvidia: give the RuntimeClass a scheduling.nodeSelector for them (for nvidia, the nodes where the NVIDIA container toolkit configured containerd), or configure the handler on node kd-faults-control-plane.
